published_source: Printed Table 4, Panel A (panel fixed effects, all years), column A (Domestic sales) of the published article (papers/mnsc/mnsc.2020.01306.pdf, p. 6936, main text), read Nov 4 2026; equals the authors' code output to the printed decimals (the article prints SEs to 3 decimals, the shipped outreg2 file to 3 significant digits; column A is outreg2 column 1, the spec's column field). Earlier: Authors' shipped output/panel_FE.txt (Table 4 top panel, outreg2, 3 significant digits); article text not in the project. Re-run of the authors' xtreg in Stata MP 16.1 matches every printed digit; full-precision values in authors_rerun_twfe_raw.
replication_status: exact (authors' code output -0.23819 (0.2311739), N 1410989, equals printed Table 4 Panel A column A -0.238 (0.231), N 1,410,989, to the printed decimals; exact_code_rerun: Stata MP 16.1 re-run of the authors' xtreg equals their shipped panel_FE.txt; verified against the article Nov 4 2026)
notes: Table 4 top panel, column 1: xtreg sales_domestic_ln certified_any i.year, fe cluster(panelid) (repl_SA8000_effects.do lines 236-241). Outcome: log(1 + domestic sales), domestic = deflated sales w99 - deflated exports w99. certified_any = 1 if certifiedpct > 0 (factory SA8000-certified for any part of the year), else 0 (missing certification data = uncertified); lines 81-82. Full main sample SA8000_main_sample.dta: large Chinese industrial firms 1998-2008, 1,448,418 factory-years, 386,582 factories; unbalanced panel (firms enter/exit the above-scale survey); no weights, no controls; factory + year FE; cluster factory. Prepared panel built in Stata from the authors' lines 13-82 (work copy ~/did_packages/_work/mnsc.2020.01306/stata/prep.do) so float storage of the log outcomes matches. fixest feols(y ~ certified_any | panelid + year, cluster = ~panelid) reproduces xtreg to 7 digits. Treated units (certified_any ever 1): 199 factories, 555 certified factory-years (matches the authors' panel_FE_factory_counts.csv). First certified_any year (factories; always-treated = first observed year in brackets): 1999:4[1], 2001:4[3], 2002:5[1], 2003:7[1], 2004:29[7], 2005:34[5], 2006:36[5], 2007:45[8], 2008:35[8]; 39 always-treated factories; 386,383 never-treated factories (99.91% of rows). cert_startyr differs from the first certified_any year for 21 factories (certification year not observed in the panel), and 7 factories with cert_startyr are never certified_any == 1 in the data (treated as never-treated, as in the authors' regression). Switch-offs: 78 factory-years (34 factories) with certified_any = 0 after first certification (lapses, certifiedpct = 0); the authors keep them as 0, run_spec.R drops them (Hull fn 6), so run_spec TWFE x outcome SD equals twfe_raw_protocol_sample, not the published coefficient. Appendix Table A9 (excluding 3 EICC firms) is a qualifying sample restriction but appendix-only; Table A10 adds a time-varying productivity control (ineligible).
